summary: Steel Aermotor lookout built 1932 on former Camp Upton land in Suffolk County; closed 1953, removed 1955 or 1956; the Long Island list says concrete footers still remain.

facts.design: Aermotor LS-40 steel tower with wood steps and landing platforms
facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1955 or 1956; the Long Island list says concrete footers still remain at the north site

events.note: Erected by the state Conservation Department (register and Long Island list); completed January 1932 per the 1932 report
January 1932 report: a man would be kept on duty March 15 to November 15 (planned)
Closed in 1953 (register and Long Island list)
Register gives 1955 by the state Conservation Department; Long Island list gives 1955 or 56 by Brookhaven National Laboratory

evidence.supports: built 1932, closed 1953, removed 1955 by the NY State Conservation Dept
evidence.quote: The tower was built in 1932, closed in 1953, and removed in 1955 by the NY State Conservation Dept. - Bureau of Forest Fire Control.

evidence.supports: Aermotor LS-40 steel tower with wood steps and landing platforms; site now Brookhaven National Laboratory
evidence.quote: This Aermotor model LS-40 with 60' concrete footings, steel structure, wood steps and landing platforms, sat on what was the U.S.Army's Camp Upton which is now the Brookhaven National Laboratory.

evidence.supports: location Brookhaven, Suffolk County, New York

evidence.quote: This site is about 3 miles northeast of the town of Yaphank, NY.
On what is now Brookhaven National Laboratory property 3 1/2 miles northeast of Yaphank.

notes_for_editor: Height disagrees: the Long Island list says 60 ft, the January 1932 report says 70 ft, so facts.height_m is omitted. Removal disagrees: the register says the state removed it in 1955; the Long Island list says Brookhaven removed it in 1955 or 56; the south page says 1956 for the steel tower. Distance from Yaphank: 3 miles (register) versus 3 1/2 miles (list). The footers 'still remain' statement comes only from the Long Island list, and the text read gives no date for it. Access is not stated by any source, so facts.access is omitted. The brief records only the 2009 registration; built, staffed, closed and removed events were added from the other sources. No corrections proposed.
